# Third-party placeholder art (not committed)

The licences of these packs allow using the assets inside a game but not redistributing
them on their own, so the files stay out of git. Without them the game draws flat colours.

| Folder | Pack | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `fantasy_battle_pack/` | "Fantasy Battle Pack" (06-07-25) — copy `Tiles/FullTileset.png` and `Tiles/WaterTiles_AnimationFrames.png` here | battle map / map preview tiles (`data/tilesets/placeholder_tileset.tres`) |
